content:wysiwyg_basic:2:74.html:
The Salvation Army Central Virginia Area Command

Richmond Shelter, Family Services & Administration

2 West Grace Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Mail to: P.O. Box 12400, Richmond, VA 23241

Phone: 804.225.7470

*We do not do walk-in intake for the shelter.
Referrals are done through Homeward's Central Intake System.
Individuals seeking shelter must call the Homeless Connection Line 804.972.0813

The Salvation Army Red Shield Youth Center

3701 R Street, Richmond, VA 23223

Phone: 804.222.3122

The Salvation Army Richmond Citadel Corps (church)

5327 Orcutt Lane, Richmond, VA 23224

Phone: 804.745.5524

content:wysiwyg_basic:5:86.html:
The Salvation Army Tri-Cities Service Center

Our Petersburg office has closed and is now online.
Visit our Get Help page to submit a rent or utility
Assistance request for locales within the Tri-Cities.

The Salvation Army Chamberlayne Avenue Emergency Shelter

1900 Chamberlayne Avenue, Richmond, VA 23222

**********

Men's Emergency Shelter
Homeless Connection Line Intake: 804-972-0813

Inclement Weather Shelter
Extreme Heat & Weather Shelter: April 16 - Nov. 14
View Cooling Center Info Sheet

Cold Weather Shelter: Nov. 15 - April 15
Main Line: 804-653-5707

Community Resource & Training Center
(Provided by the City of Richmond Dept. Of Homeless Services)
Main Line: 804-646-3111

View shelter dates, program information and operating hours

Subscribe to Our Monthly Newsletter
